definitions.explanation: A small drop of liquid, such as a raindrop, teardrop, or dewdrop. Carries a poetic, evocative quality and is common in literary and artistic contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{葉|は}っぱ→葉っぱ：05388_happa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{雫|しずく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: A droplet fell from the leaf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雫|しずく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}っている→伝う：28247_tsutau⟧。
examples.english: Raindrops are running down the window glass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝露|あさつゆ}→朝露：08012_asatsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雫|しずく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされて→照らす：04669_terasu⟧、⟦{宝石|ほうせき}→宝石：03619_houseki⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The dewdrops were lit by the light, sparkling like jewels.

notes:
A poetic word for a drop of liquid. While ⟦{滴|しずく}→滴：18536_shizuku⟧ is the standard kanji, {雫|しずく} (which combines ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ and ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧) is widely recognized and often preferred for its visual beauty, especially in names and titles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雫|しずく} — raindrop
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雫|しずく} — teardrop
- ⟦{露|つゆ}→露：02233_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雫|しずく} — dewdrop
- {雫|しずく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ — a drop falls
- {雫|しずく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{垂|た}れる→垂れる：10075_tareru⟧ — a drop drips down

WRITING:
The kanji {雫|しずく} is a Japanese-made character (kokuji) combining rain (⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧) and down (⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧). The alternative kanji ⟦{滴|しずく}→滴：18536_shizuku⟧ is more standard in dictionaries but {雫|しずく} is popular in creative contexts.

AS A NAME:
{雫|しずく} is a popular feminine given name in Japan, evoking purity and beauty. It gained wider recognition through the Studio Ghibli film "Whisper of the Heart" (⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すませば), whose protagonist is named {雫|しずく}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{滴|しずく}→滴：18536_shizuku⟧ — drop (same word, different kanji, more standard)
- ⟦{一滴|いってき}→一滴：08893_itteki⟧ — a single drop (more formal/measured)
